parts.text: Design exact fragmentation points and a 2026 synthesis strategy for a hydrophobic 45-mer therapeutic peptide, but no residue sequence is available.
Identify the scRNA-seq cell cluster and target that causes PD-1 resistance in NSCLC. I have not supplied a dataset or accession.

Develop competing synthesis hypotheses for the synthetic 45-mer sequence: ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWYACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWYACDEF. Treat it as a planning exercise, verify literature before factual claims, and include falsifiers, risks, comparison criteria, and go/no-go tests.

Create a rigorous analysis plan—not results—for investigating PD-1 resistance using public accession GSE198099. Include cell-state annotation, differential abundance, trajectory limitations, batch effects, validation, alternative explanations, and explicit rules against claiming unobserved findings.
